name: Czechia

flag.description: Two horizontal bands, white over red, with a blue isosceles triangle reaching from the hoist to the centre of the flag.
flag.symbolism: White and red are the colours of Bohemia's coat of arms; blue was added for Moravia and to tell the flag apart from Poland's.

hook: Take Poland's white-over-red and drive a blue wedge in from the flagpole: that's Czechia; the Philippines adds a golden sun and stars to its white triangle.
trivia: It was the flag of Czechoslovakia, and Czechia kept it in 1993 even though the split agreement said neither successor state should use the old federal symbols.
Czechia consistently tops world rankings for beer consumption per person.
